name: manual_bae762
claim: Negative security rules must not hardcode the concrete local fragments they forbid. Store exact private identity, attribution, device, endpoint, path, workspace, and topology fragments only in an off-repo local-only registry; tracked docs, tests, skills, and guards name categories and load the registry at runtime with synthetic fixtures for tests.

decisions.notes: PR #260 follow-up: even a guard or policy doc can self-leak by spelling the local topology it bans. The durable pattern is category-only tracked rules plus local-only configured fragments.
